_note: Facts published after the 30-Sep-2026 as-of date. NOT used in the initiation (PLAYBOOK §1); kept for the first update. Collected 25-Nov-2026.

facts.text: Rights issue allotted: 17,058,082 shares at Rs750 (Rs1,279.36 cr); issue subscribed ~1.32x at close (22-Oct-2026). Share count rises to ~196.17 mn.
Shareholding pattern (Screener, Oct-2026 column): promoters 46.22%, FIIs 15.37%, DIIs 10.82%, public 27.59% (after the rights issue; promoters appear not to have taken up their full entitlement).

Q2FY27 results: revenue from operations Rs967 cr (Screener), total revenue Rs1,019.4 cr, PAT Rs202.6 cr (associate share Rs29 cr); EPS Rs11.2. FY27 PAT guidance raised to Rs775-800 cr from ~Rs750 cr; revenue guidance unchanged.
ICICI Securities upgraded Natco to BUY (target Rs1,065 from Rs1,000): 18x FY28E EPS for the base business plus Rs145 a share NPV for exclusive products; FY27E/FY28E EPS raised 7%/12%.
USFDA Establishment Inspection Report for the Visakhapatnam formulation unit: classified VAI.
USFDA inspected the Kothur plant 12-20 Nov-2026 and issued seven Form-483 observations, which the company calls procedural.
